summary: indexed_items transforms a list so each item has its position in item.0 and value in item.1.
questions: How do I get the index while looping over a list?

answer_card.title: indexed_items lookup
answer_card.answer_md: `indexed_items` lets you loop over a list and also get each element's index: `item.0` is the position and `item.1` is the value.
